headline: Roma narrow favourites for the trip to Napoli
summary: Roma are narrow favourites for Saturday's Serie A trip to Napoli, at 37.8%, with Napoli close behind on 34.4% — a small margin, not a clear one. The handicap is level: the market rates Roma just 0.07 of a goal better, so this is close to a coin-flip game. Napoli are without first-choice centre-back Alessandro Buongiorno, out with a knee problem, and Roma also miss defender M. Bah. Over 2.5 goals is 50.9% — a genuinely split goals game. Both teams to score is 56.1%, and the draw, at 27.7%, is the least likely result.
read: Napoli's win chance has been trimmed upward in recent days while Roma drifted, and with the goals line sitting exactly on 2.5 this is priced as a tight, close-to-even game between two sides each missing a defender.
